messages:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Canary rollout v3.2.1 (runtime change: scheduler+batching knobs) started on canary-slice-17. Observed spike: tail latency x4, 500s increasing. Auto-escalation triggered. thread_ts=4120004321
alex: i'm oncall. pinging eng-runtime and oncall-sre. any quick signal on what changed?
maria-dev: this rollout included prefetch throttle and a new kv-cache affinity tweak. We expected better throughput but saw higher latency in sim. rolling out canary anyway.
lee-sre: looking at metrics -> kernel fallback rate jumped on canary hosts, and batching queue depth collapsed. Could be a miscompile of the new scheduler causing missed batching windows.
jamie-eng: CS flagged two customers with elevated API timeouts ~03:12-03:18 UTC. No broad 5xx spike but severe tail for heavy seqs.
alex: tagging product and cs. severity assessment? recommend SEV-2 unless more customers.
maria-dev: i'm flipping the runtime feature flag: runtime.new_scheduler_enabled -> false on canary (ff-off) now. Command: /ff toggle runtime.new_scheduler_enabled canary false
ops-bot: feature flag change recorded by ops-bot at 4120004385.
lee-sre: kernel fallback still elevated but batch builder started to recover after ff flip. latency down ~30% from peak. However throughput still ~15% below baseline.
maria-dev: initiating immediate rollback of canary to v3.2.0 to be safe. rolling back slice-17 now.
deploy-bot: rollback command accepted. rolling back image on canary-slice-17 -> target v3.2.0.
jamie-eng: CS: opened incident ticket INC-4120, notifying affected customers, offering workaround (shorten seq length).
alex: moving to mitigation channel: if rollback completes and metrics stabilize we de-escalate. who will own postmortem?
lee-sre: i'll take primary postmortem and coordinate with maria on the scheduler patch. please capture traces (kv cache hits, kernel fallback, batch timings).
oncall2: taking 1-hr handoff for monitoring and customer comms. I'll keep watch for ripple to other slices.
deploy-bot: rollback completed on canary-slice-17 at 4120004720. healthchecks green.
maria-dev: verifying perf: tail latency back to ~baseline, batching queue depth restored, kernel fallback rates falling. continuing to monitor for 30m.
jamie-eng: logged customer updates. CS will follow up if they see reoccurrence.
alex: closing page for now. action items: 1) maria/lee triage root cause (scheduler vs compile) 2) run targeted perf tests with longer sequences 3) patch and test before re-rollout 4) customer followups.
ops-bot: Handoff: oncall2 is owner until 4120005121.
oncall2: acknowledged. will reopen if we see any new signs. :white_check_mark:
